description.label: Description
description.value:
Minor Mental Mutation

You have an irresistible desire to fulfil an epic destiny in the likes of the heroes of legend - even if it’ll kill you. This desire might be fueled by a craving for attention, a fanatic zeal, or perhaps like the infamous Trollslayers you wish to overshadow some shameful past with an epic victory. You might even believe that you are a hero of legend reborn - an old soul - that has come to save the world again. You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.8pVzgPkgWpTJvfhG]{Fearless} (Everything) Talent. You will strive to undertake heroic challenges whenever a potentially epic moment presents itself. You won’t throw your life away needlessly however. There are many things that will kill you that aren’t epic or memorable after all. Your fate deserves to be glorious. You can only gain this mutation once.
